name: Pumper Bundles
summary: Shopify bundle app by Profit Pumper: unlimited product bundles, quantity breaks, volume and cart discounts, BOGO and free-gift offers, with cart drawer and page builder integrations. The plans are a revenue ceiling rather than a feature ladder — all four carry identical features.
best_for: shopify stores that want bundles, quantity breaks, BOGO and free-gift offers without touching code, and that value a free tier which is the complete app rather than a feature-stripped demo
skip_if: you expect more capability as you pay more — every tier here carries the same features and you are only buying a higher revenue ceiling — or you need conditional bundling logic beyond tiered discounts
honest_knock: Every tier ships the same four features, so what you are buying is a ceiling on the revenue the app is allowed to earn you. The bill therefore rises exactly when the app is working, and it rises in steps: pass $300 and you owe $9.99, pass $1,000 and you owe $29.99, pass $5,000 and you owe $49.99. Read that in both directions. It makes the free plan unusually generous — the whole app, not a stripped demo — and it makes every upgrade buy you nothing new, only permission to keep going. The one number the pricing table never defines is how that attributed extra revenue is measured, and it is the number the entire ladder rests on.

pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-09-19 on apps.shopify.com/pumper-quantity-breaks-product-bundles-discounts AND on the vendor's own site, USD; listed amounts unchanged since 2 September) Four tiers on the listing, with a 7-day free trial on the paid ones. The ladder is priced by how much extra revenue the app is allowed to generate for you, not by what it can do: the feature list — unlimited bundles and quantity breaks, chat support seven days a week, bundles on page builders, cart drawer integrations — is identical on all four. Free covers up to $300 of extra revenue generated by the app. Starter is $9.99 a month, or $94.68 a year (saves 21%), and covers up to $1,000. Growth is $29.99 a month or $269.88 a year (save 25%) and covers up to $5,000. Unlimited is $49.99 a month or $449.88 a year (save 25%) and removes the ceiling. Charges are billed in USD every 30 days. Two things on the vendor's own site contradict the listing and were unresolved on 19 September 2026: its FAQ says the trial is 14 days with full access and no card, against the listing's 7 days; and it answers 'Are there any hidden charges?' by saying Pumper charges a maximum of $39.99 a month, against the listing's $49.99 top tier. Where the two differ, the listing is the page Shopify bills from. Neither page defines how the attributed extra revenue that decides your tier is measured. The vendor trades as Profit Pumper (Henq eCommerce LLC, Delaware).

compare_with.name: AfterSell
compare_with.why: These sit at opposite ends of the same funnel: Pumper Bundles works before the buy — bundles, quantity breaks, BOGO and free-gift offers on the product page and in the cart — while AfterSell works after it, on the post-purchase and thank-you pages. Plenty of stores run both. If you are picking one, pick by where your AOV problem actually is: shoppers who never add a second item, or completed orders you never follow up on. On price Pumper is the cheaper entry, and its free tier is the full app up to $300 of attributed revenue.
